name: dsh-team-conductor
description: Unified control plane for DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams: one overview of the roster with per-member context pressure, member editing (alias/description/priority/tags/token budget/re-brief/retire/restore/compact/interrupt) plus member add/delete, runtime capacity control, a message path that reaches non-roster continuable subagents by id, and a duplicate settlement-notice guard.
